name: jenkins-playwright-vulnerability-reports
description: A Playwright V1 runner for Jenkins-rendered SonarQube and Snyk vulnerability reports.

scripts.build: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p .runner-build/reporting && cp src/reporting/report.css .runner-build/reporting/report.css
scripts.serve:report: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run build && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node .runner-build/reporting/report-server-cli.js
scripts.test:unit: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node scripts/run-playwright.mjs playwright test tests/unit --config=playwright.unit.config.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:report: PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_ONLY=1 NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node scripts/run-playwright.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/generated-report.spec.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:release: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run typecheck && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run build && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run test:unit && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run test:report
scripts.test:e2e:templates: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node scripts/run-playwright.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/template-navigation.spec.ts --config=playwright.template.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:build-now: JENKINS_BASE_URL=${JENKINS_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${JENKINS_PORT:-8080}} JENKINS_USERNAME=${JENKINS_USERNAME:-local-admin} JENKINS_PASSWORD=${JENKINS_PASSWORD:-local-fixture-password} JENKINS_JOB_PATH=playwright-vulnerability-report-build-now NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node scripts/run-playwright.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/build-now-job.spec.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test:e2e: JENKINS_BASE_URL=${JENKINS_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:${JENKINS_PORT:-8080}} JENKINS_USERNAME=${JENKINS_USERNAME:-local-admin} JENKINS_PASSWORD=${JENKINS_PASSWORD:-local-fixture-password} JENKINS_JOB_PATH=${JENKINS_JOB_PATH:-playwright-vulnerability-report} NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node scripts/run-playwright.mjs playwright test tests/e2e --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.test: NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run typecheck && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run test:unit && NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npm run test:e2e
